purpose: Exploratory four-case read-only authority preflight; not maintenance implementation or full-workload acceptance

acceptanceChecks: Classify each selected case from actual fixture/boundary behavior and historical normative sources
Identify whether reference-only maintenance preserving behavior is feasible
No repository edits or output authoring

contract.authority: Supplied historical six-document live specification family and normative artifacts only
contract.uncertainty: Declared refs are candidates, not certified governing requirements; report unresolved authority rather than inventing a mapping

loadingPolicy: Compile with a sidecar. Read task, declared metadata, mustRead chunks and unresolved summaries first; expand original sources or sidecar only for a named unresolved question. Do not load repository-wide indexes by default.
limitations: Four-case diagnosis does not establish 275-case implementation throughput
Source selectors provide no corrected mappings or expected verdicts
All preparation, failed attempts, independent review and coordinator work must remain visible
Cooperative host only; no OS-sealed acceptance claim
